method: Read public primary project/discussion pages using web.open. No authenticated action, downloads, device operations or project code execution. Exact current commit IDs were not established.

sources.observation: FX3 firmware 7.02 modification request concerned battery behaviour. The visible discussion supplied no validated MAIN HEVC HD recording or independent FX3 recovery result.
sources.scope: A single discussion cannot establish absence across the whole project or internet.

sources.observation: Users reported no-boot/cycling indicators. Later comments reported returning through an unaffected movie application path and restoring from there.
sources.inference: An application-dependent recovery report does not establish an independent rescue entry for FX3 after a movie-chain modification.
sources.scope: User reports for A7CII, not controlled FX3 7.02 verification; no claim about failure rate, root cause, repair price or all affected units.

sources.observation: The A7IV maintainer documents serial BootROM entry and a fastboot-compatible eMMC backup/restore payload; its transparent crypto handling explicitly excludes boot0 as not implemented.
sources.scope: A7IV-specific maintainer account, not FX3 rescue acceptance or evidence of a ready non-invasive Mac-only recovery path.
